title: AARO says Go Fast is possibly parallax

tellings.quote: Arrow just came to the all domain anomalous resolution office. We just, you know, we're talking about its director. Uh came out and they said that this is possibly parallax.

plain: The Go Fast video, filmed by Navy jets off Jacksonville, Florida, in 2015 and showing a small object that seems to race over the ocean, may only look fast because of parallax: the jet's own motion making a slow object appear quick against the water far below. Jesse Michels says that AARO, the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office, a Pentagon office set up to investigate unexplained objects, came out and said it is "possibly parallax". He raises this during a debate with a UFO skeptic named Mick West, and he notes that AARO says possibly, not certainly.
